name: Infographic poster (A0)
description: Three-column A0 portrait poster built with tikzposter: custom color theme, pgfplots bar and line charts, a TikZ flow diagram, an object tree, TikZ-drawn icons and highlighted inner blocks. Explains how a LaTeX document becomes a PDF.
